title: NOA Chain Facts (caller-supplied record of what the caller's OWN node returned)
description: The relying party's byte-parsed record of its own node's answers for one (network, asset, payer, correlation) coordinate set. It MUST originate from the relying party's own node and MUST NOT be accepted from the bundle producer, the observer, the facilitator or the payee — a verifier handed this record by the party being judged has been handed RECONFIRMED with no chain contact by anyone. This schema is the normative shape; packages/rail-x402 evaluates it with a strict hand-rolled structural validator (the package ships no schema evaluator), and a mirror test asserts the validator refuses what this schema refuses, field by field. The `$defs` block realizes the two references the specification's schema body names: `rfc3339` is the shipped timestamp grammar (byte-identical to noa-execution-grant-0.1.schema.json), and `canceledLog` carries the used-log COORDINATE shape without the two binding fields. S4 round-1 F1: each used log MUST carry the (nonce, authorizer) pair it was emitted for and the transfer MUST carry the (txHash, blockNumber) of the transaction it was recovered from — without those fields the record cannot express which transaction the evidence binds to, and a log or transfer lifted from an unrelated transaction is indistinguishable from the real one.
